item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera reads in her science book at home in Jaipur that Earth behaves like a giant magnet. She asks her teacher why this magnetic field is important for life on Earth. Which statement gives the correct reason?

options.A: The magnetic field makes compasses point north, which helps sailors and travellers find direction.
options.B: The magnetic field deflects many harmful cosmic rays and solar-wind particles, protecting the atmosphere and living things.
options.C: The magnetic field pulls rain clouds towards the land, giving farms enough water.
options.D: The magnetic field keeps the Moon in orbit so that tides remain regular.
